ClassNotFound.description: Test class or dependency class could not be loaded by the classloader

NoSuchMethod.description: Required method not found on the resolved class (missing native or bytecode method)

NativeMethodNotFound.description: ACC_NATIVE method invoked but no Rust implementation registered in the native bridge

VerificationError.description: Bytecode verification rejected the class file (stack map, type safety)

LinkageError.description: Class or method linking failed (incompatible class change, circular dependency)

RuntimeError.description: Uncategorized runtime error during test execution (interpreter bug, JIT miscompile)

Timeout.description: Test exceeded the per-test timeout (possible infinite loop or deadlock)

OutputMismatch.description: Test completed but produced incorrect output compared to the JCK expected output

UnsupportedFeature.description: Test exercises a JVM feature not yet implemented (e.g. certain reflection, MethodHandle combinators)
